baseline.note: Aggregate over the unchanged stationary-start diagnostic. COMs are not clamped. Synthetic unheld drift remains research-only and is excluded here.

candidate.note: 54 stationary-start recovery trials; 0.4s each, 20Hz fixed controls. COMs not clamped. No outcome fitting. Mode is explicit. Foot offset/load/command maxima sampled at tick ends, not continuous peaks. External passive load can exceed active command capacity. Synthetic drift directly resets support deviation and is not a physical impact experiment.
